IncidentEmailService implements IncidentEventListener and writes the durable email outbox.
SmtpOutboxService sends through JavaMailSender; it is not a NotificationChannel implementation.
Recipient overrides redirect outgoing mail while retaining account login addresses.
Expired reminders are not delivered; SMTP failures retry with a bounded attempt count.
